text: {"final": {"summary": "Added needs_review(household, score=None, today=None) to eligibility/rules.py. It returns False for non-active households, computes the vulnerability score via vulnerability_score(household, today) when not precomputed (mirroring is_eligible), reuses threshold_for(household), and returns threshold - 5 <= score < threshold so near-miss households (55-59 non-pregnant, 40-44 pregnant) are flagged while qualifying households (score >= threshold, including exactly at threshold) are not.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
